# Veil Protocol

Zero-knowledge privacy layer for Uniswap v4 on Robinhood Chain (EVM mainnet 4663).

- Trade terminal (Shield, ZK Swap, Withdraw, gated Trade, Vault): https://www.veilpools.tech/trade
- Treasury and burn ledger: https://www.veilpools.tech/burn
- Verified contracts registry: https://www.veilpools.tech/contracts
- Chain and pool health: https://www.veilpools.tech/status
- Association Set policy: https://www.veilpools.tech/docs/asp-policy
- Owner decisions: https://www.veilpools.tech/docs/decisions
- Privacy architecture: https://www.veilpools.tech/privacy
- Terms of service: https://www.veilpools.tech/terms
- Source code: https://github.com/veilpools/veil

Privacy notes are fixed-denomination (0.001). Withdrawals can never be paused or blocked. Fees: 30 bps hook fee, 70% buyback and burn.
